purpose: Predeclared follow-up after original CFB few-large p99 A1/B1 regression +5.02%, A2/B2 +2.80%; test reproducibility without replacing original evidence
isolation: Fresh sequential child per repetition; warmup and retained samples share process. No concurrent build/test/benchmark.
acceptance: Identical corpus/output hashes, observer v2 scopes and logical I/O; allocation calls/bytes unchanged. Strict ABBA statistic acceptance requires both paired improvements and same-role drift ceilings p50/mean 5%, p95 10%, p99 15%. Review any paired latency statistic or whole-process peak RSS regression above 5%; no averages hide individual regressions. Retain only with practical production gain and correctness gates.
timer: Existing open/query brackets, input clone and source construction outside; output semantic oracle and locality validation outside.
memory: Allocation calls include reallocations; peak/live values are process snapshots; RSS is whole-process.
limitations: No cold-cache, filesystem, remote-source or scaling claim
Whole-process RSS and PMU include untimed setup and fixture work; no exact L1/LLC claim

counters.scope: Whole process, scaled multiplexed events; not operation IPC or cache miss rate

review: Retain original and follow-up tables; review paired >5% statistics and both-direction slowdown. No improvement claim for CFB guards.
